A '''grizzly bear cub''' is a smaller version of stronger [[grizzly bear]]s and are found alongside them in [[Isafdar]]. Their drops are similar and they are fairly easy to kill.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Community Hitlist and Necromancy Embargo - This Week In RuneScape|date=22 January 2024}}
** [[Black bear]]s and [[grizzly bear]]s, including their cubs, have been graphically updated.

* {{UL|type=hidden|update=New Skill: Necromancy - This Week In RuneScape|date=7 August 2023}}
** Grizzly bears' weakness was changed from [[air spells]] to [[water spells]].

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=This Week In RuneScape - 26/10/20#Patch Notes|date=26 October 2020}}
** Monsters with multiple variants will now consistently spawn as those variants when newly placed in the [[Sunken Pyramid|Personal Slayer Dungeon]].
*** This includes bears.
